calculus.title: Calculus — derivatives intro
calculus.body: The derivative f′(a) is the limit of [f(a+h)−f(a)]/h as h→0, when that finite limit exists. It is the instantaneous rate of change and the tangent slope. For y=xⁿ with positive integer n, y′=nxⁿ⁻¹; a constant has derivative zero. A stationary point has derivative zero, but need not be a maximum or minimum.

contrast.en: A difference quotient is an average rate over an interval; the derivative is a limit at a point. At a corner such as |x| at 0 it does not exist.
contrast.ru: Разностное отношение — средняя скорость на промежутке; производная — предел в точке. В угловой точке, например у |x| при 0, производной нет.

proofs.title: Mathematical proof
items: Direct proof — A direct proof derives a statement from its hypotheses using definitions and valid logical steps. For a claim “if P, then Q”, assume P and deduce Q for an arbitrary object satisfying the hypotheses.

Proof by contradiction — A proof by contradiction assumes the negation of the desired statement together with the hypotheses, then derives incompatible conclusions. Since the hypotheses and logical rules are retained, the added negation must be false.

Proof by induction — Mathematical induction proves a claim P(n) for every integer n≥n₀. First prove P(n₀). Then, for an arbitrary k≥n₀, assume P(k) and prove P(k+1). These two steps establish all successive cases.

Counterexample — A counterexample is an allowed instance for which a universal claim fails. One such instance disproves “for every x, P(x)”. To refute “if P then Q”, the example must satisfy P while failing Q.

direct.name: Direct proof
direct.rule: A direct proof derives a statement from its hypotheses using definitions and valid logical steps. For a claim “if P, then Q”, assume P and deduce Q for an arbitrary object satisfying the hypotheses.
examples: Let a=2m and b=2n for integers m,n. Then a+b=2(m+n), and m+n is an integer, so the sum is even.

For a Euclidean triangle, draw a line through the top vertex parallel to the opposite side. Alternate angles reproduce the two base angles at that vertex; together with its angle they form a straight angle of 180°.
PROVE: a² − b² = (a−b)(a+b). Expand right side: (a−b)(a+b) = a² + ab − ab − b² = a² − b². QED.

contrast.en: Several successful examples do not prove a universal claim. State which assumptions and theorem justify each step.
contrast.ru: Несколько удачных примеров не доказывают всеобщее утверждение. Укажите условия и теоремы, обосновывающие шаги.

contradiction.name: Proof by contradiction
contradiction.rule: A proof by contradiction assumes the negation of the desired statement together with the hypotheses, then derives incompatible conclusions. Since the hypotheses and logical rules are retained, the added negation must be false.
examples: PROVE: √2 is irrational. Assume √2 IS rational, so √2 = a/b in lowest terms. Square: 2 = a²/b². So a² = 2b². a² is even → a is even → a = 2k. Then 4k² = 2b² → b² = 2k² → b also even. But a/b was in lowest terms — CONTRADICTION. So √2 is irrational.

PROVE: there are infinitely many primes. Assume finitely many: p₁, p₂, …, pₙ. Consider N = p₁·p₂·…·pₙ + 1. N is not divisible by any pᵢ (remainder 1). So either N is prime (contradicts list being complete) or has a new prime factor.

contrast.en: Negation must be precise: the negation of “all” is “there exists a counterexample”, not “none”.
contrast.ru: Отрицание должно быть точным: отрицание «для всех» — «существует контрпример», а не «ни для одного».

sources.title: Oscar Levin — Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction

induction.name: Proof by induction
induction.rule: Mathematical induction proves a claim P(n) for every integer n≥n₀. First prove P(n₀). Then, for an arbitrary k≥n₀, assume P(k) and prove P(k+1). These two steps establish all successive cases.
examples: PROVE: 1 + 2 + … + n = n(n+1)/2. Base: n=1, LHS=1, RHS=1·2/2=1. ✓ Inductive: assume true for k. Add (k+1): k(k+1)/2 + (k+1) = (k+1)(k+2)/2. ✓
PROVE: 2ⁿ > n for all positive integers. Base: 2¹=2>1. ✓ Inductive: 2^(k+1) = 2·2ᵏ > 2k ≥ k+1 (since k ≥ 1). ✓
Divisibility example: PROVE 7ⁿ − 1 is divisible by 6. Base: 7¹−1 = 6. ✓ Inductive: 7^(k+1) − 1 = 7·7ᵏ − 1 = 7(7ᵏ − 1) + 6 = 7·6m + 6 = 6(7m+1). ✓

contrast.en: The inductive assumption concerns an arbitrary k, not the conclusion for every n. The starting value need not be 1.
contrast.ru: Предположение индукции относится к произвольному k, а не к уже доказанному результату для всех n. Начальный номер не обязан быть 1.

counterexample.name: Counterexample
counterexample.rule: A counterexample is an allowed instance for which a universal claim fails. One such instance disproves “for every x, P(x)”. To refute “if P then Q”, the example must satisfy P while failing Q.
examples: CLAIM: 'all primes are odd'. Counterexample: 2 is prime AND even. Disproved.
CLAIM: 'n² > n for all positive integers'. Counterexample: n=1 gives 1²=1, NOT > 1. Disproved.
CLAIM: 'every quadratic has real roots'. Counterexample: x² + 1 = 0 has no real roots. Disproved.
CLAIM: 'if a²=b² then a=b'. Counterexample: a=−3, b=3. Both square to 9 but aren't equal.

contrast.en: A value outside the stated domain is not a counterexample. Passing many checks can support a conjecture but does not prove it for all cases.
contrast.ru: Значение вне указанной области не является контрпримером. Много удачных проверок поддерживает гипотезу, но не доказывает её для всех случаев.

numberTheory.title: Number theory basics
numberTheory.body: A prime is an integer greater than 1 with exactly two positive divisors: 1 and itself. Every integer greater than 1 is a product of primes, unique apart from their order. Congruence a≡b (mod m), for positive integer m, means m divides a−b; for example 17≡2 (mod 5).

review.russianTerm: Простое число; разложение на простые множители; сравнение по модулю

contrast.en: 1 is neither prime nor composite. Congruence means equal remainders, not equal numbers.
contrast.ru: 1 не является ни простым, ни составным. Сравнение по модулю означает одинаковые остатки, а не равенство чисел.

complex.title: Complex numbers — preview
complex.body: A complex number has form z=a+bi, where a,b are real and i²=−1. Its real part is a and imaginary part is b. The real numbers form the case b=0. In the complex numbers, x²+1=0 has solutions ±i; real square-root product rules must not be applied blindly to negative radicands.

contrast.en: The imaginary part of 2+3i is 3, not 3i. “Imaginary” is a mathematical name and does not mean invalid.
contrast.ru: Мнимая часть 2+3i равна 3, а не 3i. «Мнимая» — математическое название, а не указание на недопустимость числа.

statsExt.title: Statistics extension
statsExt.body: Population variance is the mean squared deviation from the population mean; standard deviation is its square root. The usual sample variance estimator divides the sum of squared deviations from the sample mean by n−1. Pearson correlation r describes the direction and strength of linear association between paired numerical variables and lies from −1 to 1 when both have nonzero variance.

contrast.en: Zero correlation does not rule out a nonlinear relationship. Correlation alone does not establish causation.
contrast.ru: Нулевая корреляция не исключает нелинейную связь. Одна корреляция не устанавливает причинность.

numberSystems.intro: Classification of numbers, set notation, rounding, surds, exponents, standard form and absolute values.

structureSets.name: Structure & Sets — classification, set notation
structureSets.rule: Natural numbers count: ℕ={1,2,3,…} here. Integers ℤ also include zero and negative whole numbers. Rational numbers ℚ are a/b with integers a,b and b≠0. Real numbers ℝ comprise rational and irrational numbers. Thus ℕ⊂ℤ⊂ℚ⊂ℝ. A∪B contains elements in either set; A∩B contains elements in both; ∅ is empty; x∈A means membership; A⊆B means every element of A is in B.
examples: √2 ∈ ℝ but √2 ∉ ℚ (it's irrational).
0.333… = 1/3 ∈ ℚ (recurring decimals are rational).

contrast.en: An element and a subset are different: 2∈ℕ but {2}⊆ℕ. Some books include 0 in ℕ; state the convention.
contrast.ru: Элемент и подмножество различаются: 2∈ℕ, но {2}⊆ℕ. В некоторых учебниках 0 включают в ℕ; соглашение нужно указывать.

sources.title: Oscar Levin — 5.1 Sets — Operations on Sets

rounding.name: Rounding & accuracy
rounding.rule: Rounding replaces a number by a nearby multiple of a chosen place value. Decimal places count digits after the decimal point; significant figures count from the first nonzero digit. For positive values here, a next digit 5–9 increases the retained digit; 0–4 leaves it unchanged.
examples: 0.004532 ≈ 0.005 (1 s.f.); the first significant digit is 4 and the next is 5.

contrast.en: Precision of the written result differs from accuracy relative to a true value. 1.25×10³ explicitly has three significant figures.
contrast.ru: Точность записи отличается от близости к истинному значению. Запись 1.25×10³ явно содержит три значащие цифры.

model.en: Exact halfway cases depend on the rounding convention. These examples round positive ties upward.
model.ru: Ровно половинные случаи зависят от соглашения. В этих примерах положительные половинные значения округляются вверх.

bounds.name: Upper and lower bounds (Extended)
bounds.rule: If a positive value is rounded to x to the nearest unit d using half-up rounding, its original value v satisfies x−d/2≤v<x+d/2. These endpoints are the lower and upper bounds; the interval describes rounding uncertainty.
examples: Length = 27 cm (nearest cm). LB = 26.5; UB = 27.5.
For positive distance d and time t, average speed v = d/t has lower bound d_L/t_U and upper bound d_U/t_L. A strict endpoint gives a limiting bound, not an attained minimum or maximum.

contrast.en: An upper bound need not be an attainable maximum. Endpoint inclusion changes with the tie rule; bounds do not account for every measurement error.
contrast.ru: Верхняя граница не обязательно достигается. Включение концов зависит от правила округления; границы не учитывают все погрешности измерения.

model.en: For positive distance s and time t, bounds for s/t use s_low/t_high and s_high/t_low, with t_low>0.
model.ru: Для положительных пути s и времени t границы s/t находят как s_low/t_high и s_high/t_low при t_low>0.

exponents.name: Laws of exponents
exponents.rule: For positive integer n, aⁿ is a product of n factors equal to a. Integer exponent laws: aᵐaⁿ=aᵐ⁺ⁿ, aᵐ/aⁿ=aᵐ⁻ⁿ, (aᵐ)ⁿ=aᵐⁿ and (ab)ⁿ=aⁿbⁿ. For a≠0, a⁰=1 and a⁻ⁿ=1/aⁿ. Every denominator must be nonzero.
examples: (2x³)² = 4x⁶.

contrast.en: Adding exponents requires the same base; distributing a power over a product requires the same exponent. A negative exponent means a reciprocal.
contrast.ru: Сложение показателей требует одинакового основания; степень произведения распределяют с одним показателем. Отрицательный показатель означает обратную величину.

fractionalIndices.name: Fractional indices (Extended)
fractionalIndices.rule: For a>0 and integers m,n with n>0, a^(m/n)=(ⁿ√a)ᵐ. The positive nth root is the number whose nth power is a. A negative exponent additionally takes the reciprocal.

contrast.en: √a denotes the nonnegative square root, whereas solving x²=a may give two solutions. For negative a, real roots and exponent laws require separate domain checks.
contrast.ru: √a обозначает неотрицательный квадратный корень, а уравнение x²=a может иметь два корня. Для a<0 действительные корни и свойства степеней требуют отдельной проверки области определения.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Определение корня n-ой степени

model.en: The main exponent rule here uses a>0. Even real roots require nonnegative radicands; odd roots such as ∛(−8)=−2 exist.
model.ru: Основное правило здесь дано при a>0. Для действительного корня чётной степени подкоренное выражение неотрицательно; нечётные корни, например ∛(−8)=−2, существуют.

standardForm.name: Standard form (scientific notation)
standardForm.rule: Scientific notation writes a nonzero real number as a×10ⁿ, where n is an integer and 1≤|a|<10. For positive numbers this is 1≤a<10. The coefficient holds the significant digits; n gives the power of ten. Zero is written separately as 0.
examples: Speed of light: 3 × 10⁸ m/s.

contrast.en: 5.4×10⁵=54×10⁴ numerically, but only the first is normalised scientific notation. Standard form has other meanings for polynomials.
contrast.ru: Численно 5.4×10⁵=54×10⁴, но только первая запись нормализована. Английское standard form имеет и другие значения для многочленов.

unitConversion.name: Conversion of units
unitConversion.rule: Unit conversion expresses the same quantity with another unit. Multiply by a ratio equal to one: 1 km=1000 m, 1 t=1000 kg, 1 L=1000 cm³ and 1 m³=1000 L. Square length conversion factors for area, cube them for volume, and convert numerator and denominator for compound units.
examples: 5 m² = 5 × 100 × 100 = 50,000 cm² (because 1 m² has 100×100 cm²).

contrast.en: A numerical value changes when the unit changes; the physical quantity stays the same. 1 m²=10,000 cm², not 100 cm².
contrast.ru: При смене единицы меняется числовое значение, но сама величина сохраняется. 1 м²=10 000 см², а не 100 см².

surdsSimplify.name: Surds — simplifying
surdsSimplify.rule: A surd is an irrational root of a rational number, kept in exact root form. Here we mainly use √n for positive integers n that are not perfect squares. Simplify by taking square factors out: √(a²b)=|a|√b for real a and b≥0.
examples: √(8x²)=2|x|√2 for real x; when x=−1, the result is 2√2.

contrast.en: A radical is the root notation; a surd has an irrational value. √9=3 is a radical expression but not a surd. π is irrational but is not a surd.
contrast.ru: Радикал — знак корня; surd имеет иррациональное значение. √9=3 записано с радикалом, но это не surd. Число π иррационально, но не является surd.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Определение корня n-ой степени
sources.section: Корни чётной и нечётной степени; арифметический корень

caption.en: Classify the value, not just the presence of a radical sign.
caption.ru: Классифицируйте значение, а не само наличие знака корня.

surdsOperate.name: Surds — operations & rationalising
surdsOperate.rule: Simplify radicals before combining like terms: p√d+q√d=(p+q)√d. For a,b≥0, √a√b=√(ab); for b>0, √a/√b=√(a/b). Rationalising rewrites a fraction with a rational denominator by multiplying numerator and denominator by the same nonzero factor, often a conjugate.
examples: (2+√5)(2−√5) = 4 − 5 = −1 (difference of squares).

contrast.en: A conjugate changes the middle sign: 3+√2 and 3−√2. Roots do not distribute over addition: √(a+b) is generally not √a+√b.
contrast.ru: Сопряжённые выражения отличаются знаком между слагаемыми: 3+√2 и 3−√2. Корень в общем случае не распределяется по сумме: √(a+b)≠√a+√b.

absolute.name: Absolute values
absolute.rule: For a real number x, |x| is its distance from zero on the number line: |x|=x for x≥0 and |x|=−x for x<0. Thus |x|≥0 and |a−b| is the distance between a and b.
examples: |x − 5| = 3 means x = 8 or x = 2.

contrast.en: An absolute value is a nonnegative magnitude, not a rule that always changes the sign. For k>0, |x|<k means −k<x<k; |x|>k means x<−k or x>k.
contrast.ru: Модуль — неотрицательная величина, а не правило обязательной смены знака. При k>0 условие |x|<k равносильно −k<x<k; |x|>k — условию x<−k или x>k.

mappings.name: Mappings, domain & range
mappings.rule: A function assigns exactly one output to each input in its domain. The codomain is the declared set of possible output values; the range is the subset actually attained. For f:ℝ→ℝ with f(x)=x², the domain and codomain are ℝ, but the range is [0,∞).
examples: f(x) = x², domain ℝ, range [0, ∞).
g(x) = 1/x, domain ℝ \ {0}, range ℝ \ {0}.
h(x) = √x, domain [0, ∞), range [0, ∞).
If f(x) = 3x − 2, then f(4) = 10 and f(−1) = −5.

contrast.en: Different inputs may share an output. Domain, codomain and range have different roles; a formula alone does not always specify the intended domain.
contrast.ru: Разным аргументам может соответствовать одно значение. Область определения, кодомен и область значений — разные понятия; формула не всегда полностью задаёт область определения.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Понятие функции и способы её задания
Oscar Levin — 5.2 Functions — Domain, Codomain and Range

detail.en: The attained range; codomain may be ℝ
detail.ru: Достигнутые значения; кодомен может быть ℝ

caption.en: Each input has one output. Two inputs can have the same output.
caption.ru: У каждого аргумента одно значение. У разных аргументов значения могут совпадать.

verticalLine.name: Vertical line test
verticalLine.rule: A set of points in the xy-plane is the graph of y as a function of x exactly when no vertical line meets it at more than one point. Each x in the domain must have exactly one y.
examples: y = x² PASSES — function.
x = y² (sideways parabola) FAILS — vertical line at x=1 hits y=1 and y=−1.
Circle x² + y² = 4 FAILS — not a function.

contrast.en: This checks whether y depends uniquely on x. A horizontal-line test checks a different property: whether a function is one-to-one.
contrast.ru: Проверка устанавливает единственность y при данном x. Горизонтальная прямая проверяет другое свойство: принимает ли функция каждое значение не более одного раза.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Понятие функции и способы её задания

quadraticsFactor.name: Quadratic expressions — expanding and factorising
quadraticsFactor.rule: An algebraic expression combines numbers, variables and operations, for example x²+7x+12. Terms are the added parts (x², 7x, 12); factors are multiplied parts. Expanding removes brackets by distributivity; factorising rewrites a sum as a product: x²+7x+12=(x+3)(x+4). A quadratic expression has form ax²+bx+c with a≠0.
examples: Expand: (x+3)(x−5) = x² − 2x − 15.
Factor: x² − 5x − 14 = (x−7)(x+2).
Difference of squares: x² − 9 = (x−3)(x+3).
With leading coefficient: 2x² + 7x + 3 = (2x+1)(x+3).

review.russianTerm: Квадратные выражения: раскрытие скобок и разложение на множители

contrast.en: Factorising an expression does not solve an equation. In x²+bx+c=(x+p)(x+q), p+q=b and pq=c; integer factors need not exist.
contrast.ru: Разложение выражения на множители само по себе не решает уравнение. В x²+bx+c=(x+p)(x+q) нужны p+q=b и pq=c; целые множители могут не существовать.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Алгебраические выражения
sources.section: Определение выражения; переменные и допустимые значения

detail.en: An equation, solved by x=−3 or x=−4
detail.ru: Уравнение с корнями x=−3 и x=−4

caption.en: The first two expressions have the same value for every x. Adding =0 creates an equation with particular solutions.
caption.ru: Первые два выражения равны при любом x. Условие =0 задаёт уравнение с конкретными корнями.

quadraticsGraph.name: Quadratic functions and their graphs
quadraticsGraph.rule: A quadratic function f(x)=ax²+bx+c has a≠0 and, on domain ℝ, a parabola as its graph. Its y-intercept is (0,c); x-intercepts are (r,0) where f(r)=0. The vertex is a minimum for a>0 and a maximum for a<0. Its x-coordinate is −b/(2a).
examples: y = x² − 4x + 3 opens up; y-int = 3; x-ints at x=1, x=3.
y = −x² + 4 opens down; y-int = 4; x-ints at x = ±2.
Vertex (turning point) at x = −b/(2a).

contrast.en: A root is an input value; an intercept is a point. At a repeated root the parabola touches the x-axis without crossing it.
contrast.ru: Корень — значение аргумента, а точка пересечения имеет две координаты. При двукратном корне парабола касается оси x, не пересекая её.

vertexForm.name: Vertex form
vertexForm.rule: Vertex form is y=a(x−h)²+k with a≠0. Its vertex is (h,k), axis of symmetry x=h, and extreme value k. Completing the square rewrites ax²+bx+c in this form without changing its value.
examples: y = 2x² + 8x − 3 → factor 2 from quadratic terms: 2(x² + 4x) − 3 → 2(x+2)² − 8 − 3 = 2(x+2)² − 11.

contrast.en: The sign inside the bracket is opposite to h: (x+2)² has h=−2. For a≠1, first factor a from the quadratic and linear terms.
contrast.ru: Знак в скобках противоположен h: у (x+2)² значение h=−2. При a≠1 сначала вынесите a из квадратного и линейного слагаемых.

transformations.name: Function transformations
transformations.rule: For g(x)=a f(b(x−h))+k with a,b≠0, a point (u,v) on y=f(x) maps to (h+u/b, k+av). Thus h,k translate the graph; |a| scales vertical distances and 1/|b| scales horizontal distances. Negative a or b also reflects in the relevant direction.
examples: y = (x − 3)² + 2 is y = x² shifted right 3, up 2.
y = 2x² is y = x² stretched vertically by 2.
y=(2x)²=4x² has horizontal scale factor 1/2 relative to y=x²; for this particular base function it also equals a vertical stretch by 4.
y = −sin(x) is y = sin(x) reflected in x-axis.

contrast.en: f(2x) halves horizontal distances: its horizontal scale factor is 1/2. Scaling and translation generally depend on their order.
contrast.ru: f(2x) уменьшает горизонтальные расстояния вдвое: коэффициент по горизонтали равен 1/2. Результат масштабирования и переноса обычно зависит от их порядка.

solveGeneral.name: Quadratic equations and real roots
solveGeneral.rule: An equation states that two expressions are equal. A solution is a permitted value making the equality true. A quadratic equation can be written ax²+bx+c=0 with a≠0. For real coefficients, Δ=b²−4ac gives two distinct real roots if Δ>0, one repeated root if Δ=0 and no real roots if Δ<0.
examples: x² − 4x + 4 = 0 → Δ = 0 → repeated root x = 2.
x² + x + 1 = 0 → Δ = −3 < 0 → no real solutions.

contrast.en: An expression is evaluated or transformed; an equation is solved. No real roots does not mean no complex roots.
contrast.ru: Выражение вычисляют или преобразуют; уравнение решают. Отсутствие действительных корней не означает отсутствия комплексных.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Алгебраические выражения
sources.section: Определение выражения; переменные и допустимые значения

solveFactor.name: Solving by factorisation
solveFactor.rule: The zero-product property says that a product of real numbers is zero exactly when at least one factor is zero. Write the equation as a product equal to zero, then solve each factor equation: (x−p)(x−q)=0 gives x=p or x=q.

contrast.en: This property applies to a product equal to zero, not a sum or a product equal to 5. Dividing by an unknown factor can lose zero solutions.
contrast.ru: Правило относится к произведению, равному нулю, а не к сумме или произведению, равному 5. Деление на неизвестный множитель может потерять нулевые корни.

solveCompleteSquare.name: Solving — complete the square
solveCompleteSquare.rule: Completing the square uses x²+2px=(x+p)²−p². After isolating (x+p)²=q, real solutions are x=−p±√q when q≥0; for q<0 there are no real solutions. Divide by a≠0 first when solving ax²+bx+c=0.

contrast.en: The symbol √q gives one nonnegative root; ± is needed because both opposite numbers have the same square.
contrast.ru: Символ √q означает один неотрицательный корень; знак ± нужен потому, что противоположные числа имеют одинаковый квадрат.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Определение корня n-ой степени
sources.section: Корни чётной и нечётной степени; арифметический корень

solveFormula.name: Quadratic formula
solveFormula.rule: For real a,b,c with a≠0, the quadratic formula is x=(−b±√(b²−4ac))/(2a). It gives real roots when Δ=b²−4ac≥0. Retain the full numerator over 2a and include coefficient signs. If Δ<0, real-root calculations stop here.

contrast.en: An exact answer may be rational or involve a surd. A decimal approximation should be marked ≈ and rounded only at the end.
contrast.ru: Точный ответ может быть рациональным или содержать иррациональный корень. Приближение отмечают знаком ≈ и округляют в конце.

solveGraphical.name: Solving — graphically
solveGraphical.rule: The real solutions of f(x)=0 are the x-coordinates where y=f(x) meets the x-axis. Solutions of f(x)=g(x) are the x-coordinates of intersections of their graphs, within both domains. A tangent contact counts as an intersection.
examples: x² − 4 = 0 → graph y = x² − 4, read x = ±2 where graph crosses x-axis.
Solve x² = x + 2 by plotting y = x² and y = x + 2 — intersect at x = −1, x = 2.

contrast.en: A graph usually gives estimates. A limited viewing window can miss roots, and a plotted joining line can hide a discontinuity.
contrast.ru: По графику обычно получают приближения. Ограниченное окно может скрыть корни, а соединённые точки — разрыв функции.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Понятие функции и способы её задания

rearrange.name: Changing the subject of a formula
rearrange.rule: A formula is an equation expressing a relationship between quantities. Making a variable the subject means isolating it on one side. Use reversible operations on both sides, track nonzero divisors and use the context to choose signs after taking roots.
examples: Make r the subject of A = πr². → r² = A/π → r = √(A/π).
Make t the subject of v = u + at. → t = (v − u)/a. (a≠0).
Make h the subject of V = πr²h/3 → h = 3V/(πr²). (r≠0).

review.englishTerm: Changing the subject of a formula

contrast.en: From A=πr², a radius satisfies r=√(A/π) because r≥0. From v=u+at, t=(v−u)/a requires a≠0.
contrast.ru: Из A=πr² для радиуса получаем r=√(A/π), поскольку r≥0. Из v=u+at следует t=(v−u)/a только при a≠0.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Алгебраические выражения
sources.section: Определение выражения; переменные и допустимые значения

sources.title: OpenStax — 2.2 Linear Equations in One Variable

algebraicFractions.name: Algebraic fractions (Extended)
algebraicFractions.rule: An algebraic fraction is a quotient of expressions, defined only when its denominator is nonzero. Add with a common denominator, multiply numerators and denominators, and divide by multiplying by a nonzero reciprocal. Factoring reveals common factors that can be cancelled while keeping the original exclusions.

contrast.en: Factors multiply; terms add. (x²−4)/(x−2)=x+2 for x≠2, but cancelling x in (x+1)/x is invalid.
contrast.ru: Множители перемножаются, слагаемые складываются. (x²−4)/(x−2)=x+2 при x≠2, но сокращать x в (x+1)/x нельзя.

proportions.name: Direct & inverse proportions
proportions.rule: Direct proportionality has form y=kx: y/x=k for x≠0. Inverse proportionality has form y=k/x with x≠0 and k≠0: xy=k. The constant k is fixed for the model. Proportionality to x² instead means y=kx².
examples: Cost ∝ weight. 3 kg cost £6 → k = 2, so 5 kg cost £10.
Time ∝ 1/speed. At 60 km/h trip takes 4h → k=240, so at 80 km/h takes 240/80 = 3h.
For fixed mass at non-relativistic speeds, kinetic energy E = ½mv² is proportional to v²: doubling speed multiplies E by 4.
For an isotropic point source of fixed power, with no absorption, irradiance on a surface perpendicular to the rays is proportional to 1/r².

contrast.en: A line y=mx+c with c≠0 is not direct proportionality. Inverse proportion is not merely any decreasing relationship.
contrast.ru: Прямая y=mx+c при c≠0 не задаёт прямую пропорциональность. Не всякая убывающая зависимость является обратной пропорциональностью.

model.en: Physical examples require fixed conditions: time and speed are inversely proportional only for a fixed travel distance.
model.ru: Физические примеры требуют фиксированных условий: время обратно пропорционально скорости только при заданном пути.

asymptotes.name: Rational functions — asymptotes
asymptotes.rule: An asymptote describes limiting graph behaviour. A vertical asymptote x=c occurs when function values become unbounded as x approaches c from at least one side. A horizontal asymptote y=L means f(x) approaches L as x→∞ or x→−∞. For a rational function, simplify common factors before locating poles.
examples: y = 1/(x − 3) → vertical asymptote x = 3, horizontal y = 0.
y = (x+1)/(x−2) → vertical x = 2, horizontal y = 1 (ratio of leading coefficients).
y = 1/x²: VA x = 0, HA y = 0, always positive — different from 1/x.

contrast.en: A cancelled denominator zero may be a removable hole, not a vertical asymptote. A graph can cross a horizontal asymptote.
contrast.ru: Сокращённый ноль знаменателя может дать устранимый разрыв, а не вертикальную асимптоту. График может пересекать горизонтальную асимптоту.

exponential.name: Exponential functions
exponential.rule: An exponential model has form y=A·bˣ with A>0, b>0 and b≠1 here. Equal increases of x multiply y by a fixed factor: increasing x by 1 multiplies y by b. The graph passes through (0,A); b>1 gives growth, while 0<b<1 gives decay.
examples: y = 2ˣ: doubles every unit. y(0)=1, y(3)=8.
y = 100 × 0.9ˣ models decay (e.g., depreciation).
Compound interest: A = P(1 + r)ⁿ.
Bacterial growth: N = N₀ · 2^(t/T) where T is doubling time.

contrast.en: In bˣ the variable is the exponent; in x² it is the base. Constant percentage change differs from constant absolute change.
contrast.ru: У bˣ переменная стоит в показателе, у x² — в основании. Постоянный процент изменения отличается от постоянной абсолютной прибавки.

sources.title: Российская электронная школа — Показательная функция
sources.section: Урок 21: определение, свойства и график показательной функции

model.en: Fixed growth rates are modelling assumptions. Populations and prices need not follow the same rate indefinitely.
model.ru: Постоянный темп роста — предположение модели. Численность и цены не обязаны сохранять один темп неограниченно долго.

sequences.title: Sequences & Series
sequences.intro: Linear, quadratic and geometric sequences. General rule for the nth term; sum to infinity (Extended).

subTopics.linearGeneral: Arithmetic sequences and the nth term
subTopics.geometric: Geometric sequences and the nth term

linearGeneral.name: Arithmetic sequences and the nth term
linearGeneral.rule: A sequence assigns a term uₙ to each integer index n. An arithmetic sequence has constant difference d=uₙ₊₁−uₙ. Starting at n=1 with first term a, uₙ=a+(n−1)d. Its graph consists of separate points on a line; it is not a continuous line.
examples: u₁₀ for above: 23 − 30 = −7.
What's the 100th term of 7, 12, 17, …? a=7, d=5, u₁₀₀ = 7 + 99·5 = 502.

review.englishTerm: Arithmetic sequences and the nth term
review.russianTerm: Арифметическая прогрессия и формула n-го члена

contrast.en: A term uₙ is one value; a partial sum Sₙ adds the first n terms: Sₙ=n(a+uₙ)/2.
contrast.ru: Член uₙ — одно значение; частичная сумма Sₙ складывает первые n членов: Sₙ=n(a+uₙ)/2.

linearProblems.name: Linear sequences — problem solving
linearProblems.rule: For an arithmetic sequence, u_q−u_p=(q−p)d. Two known terms determine d when p≠q, then determine a. To test whether a value occurs, solve a+(n−1)d=value and check that n is a permitted positive integer.
examples: The 5th term is 22, the 10th term is 47. Find a and d. → u₁₀ − u₅ = 5d → 47 − 22 = 25 → d = 5. Then a = 22 − 4·5 = 2.
Which term equals 200 in 3, 7, 11, …? d=4, a=3. 200 = 3 + 4(n−1) → 197 = 4(n−1) → n = 50.25 → not a term (must be integer).

contrast.en: The term value can be fractional or negative; the index here must be a positive integer. Observing a few differences does not prove the whole sequence is arithmetic.
contrast.ru: Значение члена может быть дробным или отрицательным; номер здесь должен быть натуральным. Несколько равных разностей не доказывают правило для всей последовательности.

geometric.name: Geometric sequences and the nth term
geometric.rule: A geometric sequence is generated by multiplying each term by a fixed common ratio r: uₙ₊₁=ruₙ. With first term a and n≥1, uₙ=ar^(n−1). The ratio uₙ₊₁/uₙ is usable only when uₙ≠0.
examples: Compound interest: £500 at 4% pa: 500, 520, 540.8, … → r = 1.04. After n years: 500·1.04ⁿ.

review.englishTerm: Geometric sequences and the nth term
review.russianTerm: Геометрическая прогрессия и формула n-го члена

contrast.en: Arithmetic sequences add a fixed difference; geometric sequences multiply by a fixed ratio. For a>0, r>1 gives growth and 0<r<1 gives decay; negative r alternates signs.
contrast.ru: Арифметическая прогрессия прибавляет разность, геометрическая — умножает на знаменатель. При a>0 и r>1 получается рост, при 0<r<1 — убывание; отрицательное r чередует знаки.

sumInfinity.name: Sum to infinity (Extended)
sumInfinity.rule: A series is a sum of sequence terms. Its sum to infinity is the limit of its partial sums, if that finite limit exists. For a nonzero first term a, the geometric series a+ar+ar²+… converges exactly when |r|<1; then S∞=a/(1−r).

contrast.en: Divergence need not mean growth to +∞: 1−1+1−1+… oscillates. If a=0, all terms are zero and the series sums to zero.
contrast.ru: Расходимость не обязательно означает рост к +∞: 1−1+1−1+… колеблется. При a=0 все члены нулевые и сумма равна нулю.

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Сумма бесконечной геометрической прогрессии

geometryTrig.title: Geometry & Trigonometry
geometryTrig.intro: Pythagoras, trig ratios, sine and cosine rules, circle theorems, sectors and arcs.

pythagoras.name: Pythagoras (incl. converse — Extended)
pythagoras.rule: In a Euclidean right triangle with perpendicular legs a,b and hypotenuse c, a²+b²=c². The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle. Conversely, if positive side lengths of a triangle satisfy a²+b²=c² with c the longest, its opposite angle is 90°.
examples: Sides 3, 4: hypotenuse = √(9+16) = 5.
Sides 5, 12: hypotenuse = √(25+144) = 13.
Is a triangle with sides 7, 24, 25 right-angled? 7² + 24² = 625 = 25² → YES.
3D Pythagoras: diagonal of a box a×b×c = √(a² + b² + c²).

contrast.en: The theorem concerns a right angle. A general triangle needs the cosine rule, and side lengths must be in the same units.
contrast.ru: Теорема требует прямого угла. Для произвольного треугольника нужна теорема косинусов; длины должны быть в одинаковых единицах.

trig.name: Trigonometry (SOHCAHTOA)
trig.rule: For an acute angle θ in a right triangle, sin θ=opposite leg/hypotenuse, cos θ=adjacent leg/hypotenuse and tan θ=opposite leg/adjacent leg. The side roles depend on θ; the hypotenuse is fixed. Use inverse trigonometric functions to recover the acute angle from a ratio.
examples: Find x: hyp = 10, adj = 6, θ = ? → cos θ = 6/10 → θ = cos⁻¹(0.6) ≈ 53.1°.
Find side: opp = ?, hyp = 8, θ = 30° → opp = 8·sin 30° = 4.
Tower 50 m. Angle of elevation from 80 m away: tan θ = 50/80 → θ ≈ 32°.
Angle of depression = angle of elevation (alternate angles).

contrast.en: sin⁻¹ denotes arcsin on a calculator, not 1/sin. This triangle definition uses 0°<θ<90°; unit-circle definitions extend the functions.
contrast.ru: Кнопка sin⁻¹ означает arcsin, а не 1/sin. Определение через прямоугольный треугольник использует 0°<θ<90°; единичная окружность расширяет его.

bearings.name: Bearings
bearings.rule: A three-figure bearing is a direction measured clockwise from north at the starting point. Use 000°≤θ<360°: east is 090°, south 180°, west 270°. In a plane with east-positive x and north-positive y, distance d gives offsets Δx=d sin θ and Δy=d cos θ.
examples: Bearing of B from A is 060°. Bearing of A from B: 060° + 180° = 240°.
From P, Q is at bearing 110° at 5 km. Find Q's coordinates if P at origin: Δx = 5 sin 110°, Δy = 5 cos 110°.
Back bearing = (θ + 180°) mod 360°. Thus a forward bearing of 180° gives 000°, not 360°.

contrast.en: The bearing of B from A starts at A. The reverse bearing is (θ+180°) modulo 360°, assuming parallel north directions.
contrast.ru: Азимут B из A отсчитывают в A. Обратный азимут равен (θ+180°) по модулю 360° при параллельных направлениях севера.

sources.title: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector
sources.section: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector

model.en: This is a flat-map model using one north reference; long-distance Earth navigation needs spherical geometry and a specified north reference.
model.ru: Это плоская модель с единым направлением севера; дальняя навигация по Земле требует сферической геометрии и уточнения вида севера.

sineCosine.name: Sine & Cosine rules (Extended)
sineCosine.rule: For any nondegenerate Euclidean triangle, label side a opposite angle A, and likewise b,B and c,C. The sine rule is a/sin A=b/sin B=c/sin C. The cosine rule is a²=b²+c²−2bc cos A. Choose a rule according to the known sides and angles.
examples: Sine rule (AAS): angles 40°, 60°, side opp 60° = 8. Side opp 40°: 8 sin 40° / sin 60° ≈ 5.94.
Sides 7 cm and 9 cm include 50°. The third side is √(49+81−126 cos 50°)≈7.00 cm.

contrast.en: Both rules also work for right triangles. SSA data can produce zero, one or two triangles; arcsin alone does not resolve the ambiguity.
contrast.ru: Обе теоремы действуют и для прямоугольных треугольников. Две стороны и угол не между ними могут дать ноль, один или два треугольника; одного arcsin недостаточно.

triangleArea.name: Area using ½ab·sin(C)
triangleArea.rule: For two sides a,b and their included angle C, triangle area is A=½ab sin C. This follows from ½×base×perpendicular height with height b sin C. It applies to acute, right and obtuse nondegenerate triangles.
examples: Sides 6 cm and 8 cm, angle between them 30°: Area = ½·6·8·sin 30° = 12 cm².
Equilateral side 10: Area = ½·10·10·sin 60° = 25√3 ≈ 43.3.
Compare with traditional Area = ½ base · height — same answer but ½ab sin C doesn't need height.

contrast.en: C must lie between the two chosen sides. Area uses squared units; an angle elsewhere cannot be substituted unchanged.
contrast.ru: C должен находиться между выбранными сторонами. Площадь выражается в квадратных единицах; другой угол нельзя подставить вместо C.

circleTheorems.name: Circle theorems
circleTheorems.rule: A chord joins two points of a circle; an arc is part of its circumference; a tangent touches at one point. An inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending its intercepted arc. Angles in the same segment are equal; an angle subtending a diameter is 90°. Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°. A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at contact; tangents from one external point have equal lengths.
examples: Angle at centre 80° → angle at circumference (same arc) = 40°.
Triangle inscribed in semicircle with diameter as one side: opposite angle = 90°.
ABCD cyclic, ∠A = 70° → ∠C = 110°.

contrast.en: The intercepted arc excludes the inscribed angle’s vertex. For the tangent–chord theorem, choose the angle in the alternate segment; do not just match any angle.
contrast.ru: Перехваченная дуга не содержит вершину вписанного угла. В теореме об угле между касательной и хордой выбирайте вписанный угол в противоположном сегменте.

sources.title: AMSI — Circle Geometry
sources.section: Angles in circles; tangents; intersecting chords

sources.title: Фоксфорд Учебник — Вписанный и центральный углы
sources.section: Теорема о вписанном угле и следствия

sectors.name: Sectors and arcs
sectors.rule: A sector is the region bounded by two radii and their connecting arc. For radius r>0 and central angle θ in degrees, arc length L=(θ/360°)·2πr and sector area A=(θ/360°)·πr². In radians these become L=rθ and A=½r²θ.
examples: If arc length = 10 and r = 4, then θ = (10/(2π·4)) · 360° ≈ 143.2°.

contrast.en: An arc is a length on the circumference; a sector is an area. A segment is bounded by a chord and an arc, rather than by two radii.
contrast.ru: Дуга — линия на окружности, её измеряют длиной; сектор — область, её измеряют площадью. Сегмент ограничен хордой и дугой, а не двумя радиусами.

sources.title: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector
sources.section: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector

segments.name: Area of a segment
segments.rule: A circular segment is the region between a chord and one of its arcs. For the minor arc with 0°<θ≤180°, area=sector area−triangle area=(θ/360°)πr²−½r² sin θ. The major segment is the rest of the circle: πr² minus the minor segment.
examples: r = 6, θ = 90°: sector = π·36/4 = 9π. Triangle = ½·6·6·sin 90° = 18. Segment = 9π − 18 ≈ 10.27.

contrast.en: Sector and segment share an arc but have different straight boundaries. The positive triangle-subtraction picture applies to minor segments.
contrast.ru: У сектора и сегмента может быть общая дуга, но разные прямолинейные границы. Вычитание положительной площади треугольника относится к меньшему сегменту.

sources.title: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector
sources.section: 7.1 Angles — Arc Length and Area of a Sector

model.en: The calculator allows a major arc too: ½r²(θ−sin θ), with θ in radians, uses a signed sine term for π<θ<2π.
model.ru: Калькулятор допускает и большую дугу: ½r²(θ−sin θ), где θ в радианах, использует знак синуса при π<θ<2π.

intersectingChords.name: Intersecting chords
intersectingChords.rule: If chords AB and CD meet at an interior point P of the same circle, their segment lengths satisfy AP·PB=CP·PD. For two secants through an exterior point P, with A,C the near points and B,D the far points, PA·PB=PC·PD.
examples: Chord AB and chord CD cross at P. AP = 6, PB = 4, CP = 3. Find PD: 6·4 = 3·PD → PD = 8.
If P is OUTSIDE circle with two secants: PA·PB = PC·PD (still products of full distances from P to far intersection times near).

contrast.en: Inside, multiply the two parts of each chord. Outside, multiply the near distance by the full distance from P to the far intersection.
contrast.ru: Внутри перемножаются две части каждой хорды. Снаружи — ближний отрезок и весь отрезок от P до дальней точки пересечения.

sources.section: Angles in circles; tangents; intersecting chords

sources.section: Теорема о вписанном угле и следствия

statsProb.title: Statistics & Probability
statsProb.intro: Histograms, box plots, stem-and-leaf plots, grouped data, cumulative frequency, standard deviation (Extended).

representation.name: Data representation — choosing the right chart
representation.rule: Categorical data record labels or classes. Numerical data record counts or measurements; discrete values are separate possibilities, while a continuous variable can take any value in an interval. A bar chart compares categories, a histogram groups numerical values, a line graph shows ordered change, and a scatter plot shows paired numerical observations.
examples: Favourite ice cream flavour → bar chart (categorical).
Heights of students → histogram (continuous data, grouped).
Goals scored per match → bar chart (discrete count).
Temperature vs ice cream sales → scatter graph.

review.englishTerm: Data representation — choosing the right chart

contrast.en: A number used as a label, such as a bus route, need not be quantitative. Histogram intervals have numerical widths; bar-chart categories do not.
contrast.ru: Число-метка, например номер маршрута, не обязательно количественно. Интервалы гистограммы имеют числовую ширину; категории столбчатой диаграммы — нет.

stemLeaf.name: Stem and leaf diagram
stemLeaf.rule: A stem-and-leaf plot splits each data value at a chosen place value into a stem and a final digit called a leaf. Repeated values keep repeated leaves. Ordered leaves show distribution while preserving the recorded values. A key specifies the scale, for example 2|3=23 or 2|3=2.3.
examples: Back-to-back stem-leaf compares two groups: e.g., boys vs girls heights with shared stems in the middle.

contrast.en: The stem is not always tens. In a back-to-back plot, read each side away from the common stems; include units in the key.
contrast.ru: Стебель не всегда означает десятки. У двусторонней диаграммы каждую сторону читают от общих стеблей; в ключе укажите единицы.

grouped.name: Grouped data — mean, median, mode
grouped.rule: Grouped data record frequencies in nonoverlapping intervals, losing exact individual values. Estimate the mean by Σ(frequency×class midpoint)/Σfrequency. The median splits ordered data into halves; grouping usually identifies its class, with interpolation needed for an estimate. For equal-width classes, the modal class has the greatest frequency.
examples: Intervals [0,10), [10,20), [20,30] have frequencies 4,10,6 and midpoints 5,15,25. Estimated mean=(5·4+15·10+25·6)/20=16.
The modal class is [10,20); both middle observations (10th and 11th) lie there.
A linear grouped-data median estimate uses 10+(10−4)/10·10=16; the exact median is unknown.

contrast.en: Mean, median and mode are distinct measures of centre. For unequal intervals, compare frequency density for the histogram peak; the exact mode is not known from grouped counts.
contrast.ru: Среднее, медиана и мода — разные характеристики центра. При неравных интервалах пик гистограммы определяют по плотности частоты; точная мода по группам неизвестна.

boxPlots.name: Box plots (box-and-whisker)
boxPlots.rule: A box plot marks the median and quartiles Q1,Q3; the box covers the middle half of the data and IQR=Q3−Q1. In a modified box plot, flag values below Q1−1.5·IQR or above Q3+1.5·IQR as potential outliers, and draw whiskers to the most extreme unflagged observations.
examples: Comparing: 'Group A has higher median and larger IQR — more variable than Group B'.

contrast.en: A basic five-number box plot uses min/max whiskers. Do not mix that convention with modified whiskers. A flagged outlier is not automatically an error.
contrast.ru: У простого ящика по пяти числам усы идут до минимума и максимума. Это другое соглашение. Отмеченный выброс не обязательно является ошибкой.

model.en: Here quartiles are medians of the lower and upper halves, excluding the overall median when n is odd. Software can use other conventions.
model.ru: Здесь квартили — медианы нижней и верхней половин; общая медиана при нечётном n исключается. Программы могут использовать другие соглашения.

histograms.name: Histograms (incl. unequal class widths)
histograms.rule: A histogram displays frequencies across numerical intervals. When the vertical axis is frequency density, height=frequency/class width and rectangle area=frequency. Adjacent intervals meet at their boundary; an empty interval can create a gap. Unequal widths require area-based comparison.
examples: Classes: 0–10 (freq 20, width 10, density 2). 10–30 (freq 60, width 20, density 3). 30–60 (freq 30, width 30, density 1).
Total frequency = sum of (density × width). Check: 2·10 + 3·20 + 1·30 = 110.

contrast.en: Bar height alone is not frequency for unequal widths. With equal widths a frequency-height scale is possible, but area is then proportional to frequency.
contrast.ru: При разной ширине сама высота не равна частоте. При равной ширине допустима ось частоты; площадь тогда пропорциональна частоте.

caption.en: These bars have different heights but the same frequency; height is frequency density.
caption.ru: Высоты различаются, но частоты одинаковы; высота задаёт плотность частоты.

cumulativeFreq.name: Cumulative frequency and percentiles
cumulativeFreq.rule: Cumulative frequency is the running total up to a value. For grouped data, plot totals at upper class boundaries and start at the lowest boundary with zero. The graph cannot decrease. Read a pth percentile at cumulative frequency (p/100)N, interpolating between boundaries when necessary.
examples: Linear estimates: median at CF=10 gives 16; Q1 at CF=5 gives 11; Q3 at CF=15 gives 21.67.
90th percentile at CF=18 gives 26.67.

contrast.en: The graph need not be S-shaped. Grouped percentiles are estimates, and flat sections have no observations; do not divide by a zero frequency.
contrast.ru: График не обязан иметь S-образную форму. Процентили по группам — оценки; горизонтальные участки означают отсутствие наблюдений, на нулевую частоту делить нельзя.

model.en: Straight-line interpolation assumes values are spread uniformly inside each interval; the original individual values are unknown.
model.ru: Линейная интерполяция предполагает равномерное распределение внутри интервала; исходные отдельные значения неизвестны.

stdDev.name: Standard deviation (Extended)
stdDev.rule: For a complete finite population x₁,…,x_N with mean μ, variance is σ²=Σ(xᵢ−μ)²/N and standard deviation is σ=√σ². To estimate population variance from a random sample of n>1 observations, use s²=Σ(xᵢ−x̄)²/(n−1). Standard deviation measures spread in the original units.
examples: Compare: data 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5.5 has same mean 5, but σ ≈ 0.289. Much more consistent.

contrast.en: Variance has squared units. The 68% within one standard deviation rule describes a normal distribution, not arbitrary data.
contrast.ru: Дисперсия имеет квадратные единицы. Правило о 68% в пределах одного стандартного отклонения относится к нормальному распределению, а не к любым данным.

pieCharts.name: Pie charts
pieCharts.rule: A pie chart divides a circle into sectors representing nonoverlapping categories of one whole. A category with frequency f out of total N>0 has angle 360°·f/N. All categories together account for 100% and 360°.
examples: Survey of 60 people: 20 walk, 10 cycle, 30 drive. Angles: walk 120°, cycle 60°, drive 180°. Total 360° ✓.
If sector for 'cycle' = 30° in pie of 240 students, count = (30/360)·240 = 20 cyclists.

contrast.en: A category sector shows a proportion, not a raw count without the total. Overlapping categories or multiple-choice responses may not form one whole.
contrast.ru: Сектор показывает долю; без общего числа он не задаёт количество. Пересекающиеся категории или ответы с множественным выбором могут не составлять одно целое.

quadraticExplorer.description: Explore y=ax²+bx+c. For a≠0 the graph is a parabola; for a=0 it becomes linear or constant. The viewing window can hide roots.

contrast.en: A root is an input value; an intercept is a point. At a repeated root the parabola touches the x-axis without crossing it.
contrast.ru: Корень — значение аргумента, а точка пересечения имеет две координаты. При двукратном корне парабола касается оси x, не пересекая её.

sequenceGenerator.title: Sequence Generator
sequenceGenerator.description: Generate terms indexed by n=1,2,…: add d for arithmetic sequences or multiply by r for geometric ones. Dots mark discrete terms.

review.englishTerm: Geometric sequences and the nth term
review.russianTerm: Геометрическая прогрессия и формула n-го члена

contrast.en: Arithmetic sequences add a fixed difference; geometric sequences multiply by a fixed ratio. For a>0, r>1 gives growth and 0<r<1 gives decay; negative r alternates signs.
contrast.ru: Арифметическая прогрессия прибавляет разность, геометрическая — умножает на знаменатель. При a>0 и r>1 получается рост, при 0<r<1 — убывание; отрицательное r чередует знаки.

sequenceGenerator.alt: Discrete sequence dots at positive integer indices. The full list of terms is printed above.

sectorSegment.title: Sector & Segment Calculator
sectorSegment.description: Blue shows the sector bounded by radii; orange shows the segment bounded by chord and arc. Angles above 180° select the major arc and major segment.

contrast.en: Sector and segment share an arc but have different straight boundaries. The positive triangle-subtraction picture applies to minor segments.
contrast.ru: У сектора и сегмента может быть общая дуга, но разные прямолинейные границы. Вычитание положительной площади треугольника относится к меньшему сегменту.

surdSimplifier.title: Surd Simplifier
surdSimplifier.description: Simplify √n for integers 1≤n≤1000. A perfect-square input produces a rational result; not every radical is a surd.

contrast.en: A radical is the root notation; a surd has an irrational value. √9=3 is a radical expression but not a surd. π is irrational but is not a surd.
contrast.ru: Радикал — знак корня; surd имеет иррациональное значение. √9=3 записано с радикалом, но это не surd. Число π иррационально, но не является surd.

transformations.title: Function Transformations
transformations.description: Transform a graph by y=a·f(x−h)+k. Sine uses radians; reciprocal curves have gaps at excluded inputs. The case a=0 keeps the original domain.

contrast.en: f(2x) halves horizontal distances: its horizontal scale factor is 1/2. Scaling and translation generally depend on their order.
contrast.ru: f(2x) уменьшает горизонтальные расстояния вдвое: коэффициент по горизонтали равен 1/2. Результат масштабирования и переноса обычно зависит от их порядка.

numberSetsVenn.description: Classify exact integer/fraction/finite-decimal inputs, π, e, and integer multiples of √n (0≤n≤1,000,000). Here ℕ starts at 1. Other expressions are unsupported.
numberSetsVenn.irrational: Irrational: belongs to ℝ and not ℚ (among the four sets shown).
numberSetsVenn.properFraction: A non-integer rational number: belongs to ℚ and ℝ.

contrast.ru: Элемент и подмножество различаются: 2∈ℕ, но {2}⊆ℕ. В некоторых учебниках 0 включают в ℕ; соглашение нужно указывать.

circleTheorems.title: Circle Theorems Playground
circleTheorems.description: Explore valid Euclidean circle constructions: the inscribed-angle, semicircle, cyclic-quadrilateral and intersecting-chord theorems.
circleTheorems.ruleCentre: The central angle subtending the intercepted arc is twice the inscribed angle; C is not on that arc.
circleTheorems.ruleSemicircle: For diameter AB and C on the circle distinct from A,B, ∠ACB=90°.
circleTheorems.ruleCyclic: Opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°.
circleTheorems.ruleChords: When two chords intersect, the products of their segments are equal: AP × PB = CP × PD.

contrast.en: The intercepted arc excludes the inscribed angle’s vertex. For the tangent–chord theorem, choose the angle in the alternate segment; do not just match any angle.
contrast.ru: Перехваченная дуга не содержит вершину вписанного угла. В теореме об угле между касательной и хордой выбирайте вписанный угол в противоположном сегменте.
